players.product: gold bonding wire and solder balls

quarterly_data.signal: IR deck (06-30-2026): the company says it is global No.1 in bonding-wire sales with a 22% market share (unnamed competitors C 21%, B 20%, A 18%, others 19%) and expects bonding-wire demand to keep growing, including for SOCAMM; it cites production capacity of 60~65 ten-thousand km per month across the Korea HQ and the Kunshan (China) subsidiary. In solder balls it says it is global No.3 with a 15% share, offering high-reliability (HQM, MXT), low-temperature (LTS) and Cu-core (CCSB) grades and expecting structural demand growth from high-density, high-performance packaging. New businesses shown: in-house flux and solder paste (company says first in Korea) for semiconductor, memory-module, mobile and automotive uses, and Pd-alloy material for the top plunger of test-socket pogo pins.
quarterly_data.figure: Bonding-wire share 22% (No.1, company claim); solder-ball share 15% (No.3); capacity 60~65 ten-thousand km/month
